US Considers Stricter Visa Rules, Potentially Affecting Indians

The Trump administration is reportedly considering new regulations that could tighten rules for H-1B, green card, and student visas. These potential changes could significantly impact individuals seeking to work or study in the United States, with a notable effect anticipated for Indian citizens. The specifics of the proposed rules and their full implications are still emerging.
